note_on_seed0: seed0's checkpoint predates this task (git_sha ba35b513, PR #58's own bounded-replay validation was a SEPARATE 20-epoch replay of seed0's config, not a re-run of the real seed0 training). seed0's OWN original training log (av2_scaleup_v2_10k_generic_robust_bs64_lr004_seed0_train.log) shows the real run permanently collapsed to NaN at epoch 16 (val_loss=nan, grad_norm=nan) and stayed NaN through patience exhaustion at epoch 21. Its retained checkpoint (best_epoch=6) is safe only because the best-checkpoint mechanism saved it BEFORE the later collapse -- it is not evidence the PR#58 guard survived a real full run. Only seed1 and seed2 (trained under this task, with the finalized guard active throughout) demonstrate a complete run reaching natural patience-based early stopping with zero catastrophic/permanent collapse despite repeated STATE B (norm-overflow) and STATE C (element-nonfinite) events.
